gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED v2. A tester reports a v1 entry-to-game freeze; keep runtime off in all presets pending the diagnostic matrix.

input_constraints: User-owned pinned NFL 2K5 USA disc with retail HUD resources, or a completely recognized runtime installation.
Use a disposable output copy; reserve the selected allocator owner union before installing hooks.
An XBE alone cannot install the required 264 native panel textures. Rebuild from base when changing the owner set.
portme: Apply the r62 scorebug section of WIRING.md, disable automatic runtime selection and regenerate the protected reservation manifest.
Run the six-profile matrix and static 4:3/widescreen witness list in ASTRA_SCOREBUG_FIX_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute the compiler and recipes; derive native resources from the user's own disc. Do not distribute generated game resources, executables or discs.

runtime.scope: The earlier v1 runtime build froze entering gameplay in xemu on macOS; that failure is not reproduced or fixed here. v2 has bounded native collection, allocation, decompression, lookup and event checks. OS asynchronous lifetime, GPU consumption and live memory pressure remain unproved.

fields.allowed: false in every preset; manual true implies scorebug and xbe_space and selects the full diagnostic profile

selectors.notes: Implies scorebug and xbe_space. Relocated kickoff is independent and requires its existing alignment prerequisites.
